name: ci-test-workflow
title: CI: go vet + go test workflow on push to main
description: Add a GitHub Actions workflow that runs go vet ./... and go test ./internal/... on every push to main, with TDLib C library available for cgo compilation. Closes the platform-verification gap: Windows dev machines cannot build go-tdlib (cgo-only), so the spec-required vet+test validation currently has no CI channel.
creator: killbus
